title: Integrate source-obligation contracts with clause producers and readiness gates
description: Follow-up implementation work after the clause IR contract correction. Update future clause producers/projectors to populate source-backed obligations with exact source-span locators and source-specific predicates, then wire evaluator semantic results and independent readiness gates into the importer/audit consumers. Preserve the narrow contract-only scope of eshyra-o9bd.19.1.1.2 and prove no silent partial projection in producer fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: All mechanics-bearing clause producers emit at least one span-bound source obligation; composed source obligations survive projection; semantic completeness and CAPTURED/PROJECTED/SUPPORTED/DISCOVERABLE readiness remain independently reported by consumers; integration tests cover a composed clause and a missing obligation.
